apps.subtitle: Windows games on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: A fast, controller-friendly launcher that runs Windows games on iOS and iPadOS with Steam and GOG built in, powered by Wine, FEX and Metal via DXMT.

versions.localizedDescription:
**BCD is in alpha:** an early stage of development, before beta. Many games run, many do not yet, and things can break between builds. When a game fails, please send a log.

> **Tried one of these games on an earlier build? Reset its settings first.** A game keeps the settings it had until you reset them, so without this it may start with the old ones that failed. On the game's page: **Options › Recommended settings › Reset to Recommended**, then check that **Options › Auto-tune › Auto-tune this game** is on, and start the game again.

This build fixes failures found in the logs you sent with Send Log since 0.1.579. Each fix targets the error a log showed; none of them could be tested on a device yet, so a game may now get further and still stop at a later point. If it does, please send a new log: it names the next problem.

- **Resident Evil 2 and Resident Evil 7 biohazard:** the game closed when it played one of its videos (in Resident Evil 2 right after the first cutscene). BCD can now play the games' Windows Media videos; their recommended settings turn this on.
- **BCD closing by itself:** fixed BCD closing when you opened a game's page or the in-game menu after a game had stopped.
- **The Desktop:** 32-bit programs started from the library's Desktop (for example the Battle.net installer) no longer close as soon as they start.
- **Steam games that Steam cannot start:** when Valve's client cannot start a game (for example its copy protection cannot prepare it: Spec Ops: The Line, Risen 2), BCD now ends the session after 20 seconds and says why, instead of waiting on an empty desktop. BCD Dock also explains error 42 (Firewatch).
- **Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy:** BCD no longer stays on "running" after the game closed (its name made BCD take it for a crash reporter).
- **Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered and Miles Morales:** the game closed at once when it asked for a texture with no size; BCD now answers that request with an error, as Windows does.
- **Need for Speed Underground 2:** fixed the game closing a few seconds after start when it copied code across a memory page boundary.
- **Jetboard Joust** (and other games built on .NET): fixed the game stopping at start because BCD did not complete one of the runtime's memory operations.
- **Grand Theft Auto IV (Steam):** on installs where a 64-bit vcruntime140.dll had been put into Windows' own folder, auto-tune's fix for "MSVCP140.dll failed to initialize" now works there too.
- **Recommended settings for more games:** STAR WARS Galactic Racer, BeamNG.drive, BlazBlue Entropy Effect, DARK SOULS III, Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered, RAIDOU Remastered, Yakuza: Like a Dragon, Batman: Arkham City GOTY, METAL GEAR SOLID: Peace Walker, Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders, No Rest for the Wicked, Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter, Subnautica 2, Red Dead Redemption, Resident Evil 2 and Resident Evil 7 biohazard, also through the online list.
- **Auto-tune:** no longer tries the AVX setting for crashes that are not a missing instruction (Jetboard Joust, Portal) or a window size for a program no window can hold (Persona 4 Golden); recognises Dark Souls III's self-modifying-code crash; no longer counts a normal quit as a crash when a leftover thread faults after the game exited (Shade); keeps a setting that got a game past loading (RAIDOU Remastered); and a session the user left without a crash is no longer a failure.
- **A larger memory window that could not be set up:** when a game then stops with error 0xC0000018, BCD now tells you to quit and reopen it.
- **Send Log:** logs name more causes (what a 64-bit launcher sees of Steam when it says Steam is not running; why a 32-bit program cannot reach Windows' drawing table), and Spelunky 2 no longer writes a half-gigabyte log.
- **About:** the version now says alpha.

Install help, game reports and ideas: the BCD-Games Discord is open, https://discord.gg/43TmupTVug

**BCD.ipa**: the unsigned IPA, for sideloading with SideStore, AltStore or LiveContainer. It needs iOS 18 or later and JIT; the README has the details.
**BCD-source.tar.xz**: the complete source of this build with all its submodules (GPL-3.0).
